rubrics.justification: Accurately interprets the provided Gardner 0DD data as very poor-quality with absent/degenerative ICM and TE, but no image was available and it adds some speculative statements about viability and timing nuances beyond direct morphology.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, maturity rate, smoking, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status well, though some links to embryo failure are somewhat speculative.

Overall logic is clear and consistent: extremely poor embryo grade drives very low implantation despite favorable age/endometrium. Minor issues include overconfidence about non-viability and assumptions from limited cycle data.

Mostly aligned on poor prognosis of a 0DD embryo and lifestyle optimization, but includes less guideline-grounded recommendations such as routine antioxidants/DHEA, strong cancellation language, and broad PGT-A suggestion in a 30-year-old.

Provides clear practical next steps for counseling, smoking cessation, trigger review, culture strategy, and future planning, though some recommendations are more prescriptive than the evidence supports.
